name: QuakeSpasm-Spiked
summary: QuakeSpasm with FTE's networking bolted on, and the one QuakeSpasm derivative that hosts a dedicated server.
description:
QSS exists for the networking, so it is the QuakeSpasm-family profile that declares `host_dedicated`. Everything else about its command line is QuakeSpasm's.

This profile was written from QuakeSpasm-Spiked's own published command-line documentation, not from a build running on this machine. That is what every `unverified` platform below means, and it is why there is no version probe: asking a Quake engine what version it is means starting it, and starting it means opening a window and a game.

`play_map` names a game directory as well as a map, because that is what these engines' command lines do: `-game` chooses which directory the map is loaded from. Launching a map into a directory nobody named is how you end up watching the wrong map.

license.notice: Quake engine source ports are separate programs under their own licences. This profile configures one; it does not contain, link or relicense it. Game data — PAK files, maps, textures and sounds shipped with a commercial release — is not covered by that licence, and the Companion never copies, uploads or redistributes it.
